_note: The ad gate. Upstream checks IMPRESSION RECORDS, not merely that a Gravity session exists (server.mjs:294). GET /ads/next returns 204 when there is no ad to serve, which is normal and not an error.

_impression_policy: imp_fired:true is sent ONLY after the creative was actually painted in the dashboard. hungkevin's proxy fires this on a 10-minute timer with nothing displayed; we do not, because an impression nobody saw is a false report to the advertiser whose spend funds the inference.
